How we make customers buy from you

/01

We will find your strengths

You know far more about your business than you have time to tell customers. We will bring out the essentials: why people choose you, why they come back and what stops them from buying.

/02

We will show them to customers

We will turn them into convincing arguments and present them on the website so that within a minute a visitor understands why they should choose you.

/03

We will remove buyer doubts

We answer objections right on the website, so orders are placed without questions in direct messages.

/04

We will increase the average order value

Upsells in the cart and on product pages plus a loyalty program, so customers buy more and come back.

/05

We will prepare it for traffic

Together we will define how you plan to attract customers: SEO, Google and Meta ads, social media or AI assistants, and prepare the website for exactly these channels.

We agree on every stage so the website is effective and you love it

Your part: answer the brief questions and approve decisions. You can request changes to get the best result.

/01
Free consultation
/01

Brief

We define the goals of the online store, your positioning and business specifics, your audience, your main competitors and how you plan to promote the website.

/02

Research

We analyze competitor websites, research the audience and study what matters in your niche. This shows us what is already on the market and how you can stand out.

/03

Prototype

We make a black and white layout of the website with all the logic and functionality, and plan the buyer's path from the first screen to payment.

/04

Moodboard

We collect examples you like, what we learned from the brief and what we suggest based on the analysis. As a result, we agree on the website style.

/05

Design

First we approve the first 2 screens to finalize the style, then design the whole website in the approved style.

/06

Responsive design

We adapt the design for tablets and phones so the website looks perfect on every device.

/07

Development and launch

We build the design on Shopify or WordPress and set up payments, delivery, CRM and any other functionality you need. We test the website on different devices.

/08

Support

We teach you to add products and change prices and promotions yourself, and provide support for a period that depends on your plan. After it ends, you can still contact us with any questions.

How much does an online store cost?

We calculate the final price after reviewing the project and send you a proposal with options.

Basic

When you need it simple and fast (Shopify / WordPress template)

$500from
Choose the Basic plan
  • Texts and structure provided by the client
  • Simple design
  • One round of revisions per stage
  • Responsive for all devices
  • Basic SEO setup
  • Development on a Shopify / WordPress template
  • Testing and launch
  • One month of support

Standard

When you need a website for years (Shopify / WordPress)

$1000from
Choose the Standard plan

Everything in the Basic plan, plus:

  • Business, audience and competitor analysis
  • Sitemap and structure
  • Text rewriting
  • Custom design
  • Two rounds of revisions per stage
  • Development on Shopify / WordPress
  • Two months of support

Premium

When you need complex functionality (custom development, Shopify / WordPress)

$1500from
Choose the Premium plan

Everything in the Standard plan, plus:

  • Original copywriting
  • Three rounds of revisions per stage
  • Custom development or Shopify / WordPress
  • A well thought out upsell system
  • Complex functionality and integrations
  • Three months of support

Frequently asked questions

Still have questions?
Write to us on Telegram.

Write on Telegram
/01How long does it take to develop an online store?

The timeline depends on the scope of work and whether the content is ready: on the Basic plan from 5 days, Standard from 10 days, Premium from 20 days.

/02Who adds the products to the website?

Every plan includes adding 20 products. Each additional product with up to 5 variants (sizes, colors, etc.) costs $1, with more variants $2. If you do not have product descriptions, we can generate them for $1 per product.

/03Which platform is best for an online store?

We choose based on your task. Shopify is suitable for any task and especially for selling internationally. WordPress lets you build any functionality. We offer custom development on the Premium plan for stores with complex functionality.

/04What is SEO and is it included in the price?

SEO helps people find your store on Google when they search for your products. Development includes basic SEO: page titles and descriptions, a logical catalog structure and preparing the website for indexing. SEO setup for product pages is separate, $2 per product. Ongoing promotion after launch is a separate job for an SEO specialist.

/05Do I have to connect online payments?

No, the store can accept orders without them. We connect online payments if you need them.

/06Will I be able to make changes to the website myself?

Yes, we will record a video tutorial on how to use the website and make changes yourself. Or you can always contact us, and we will estimate the work and its price.

/07Do you work under a contract?

Yes, we work under a contract. It sets out the task, deadlines, price and scope of work.

/08What do I pay for separately, besides your services?

The platform plan or hosting, the domain and, if needed, paid services or plugins. These payments go directly to the platform and the registrar, so the website and domain are registered in your name.

/09How do I promote the website after launch?

At the brief stage, we define together how you plan to attract customers: SEO, Google and Meta ads or social media, and prepare the website for these channels. If you need help with promotion, we will recommend trusted specialists.

/10What other services do you offer?

Besides turnkey development: website design in Figma for your developer, redesign of your current website, development based on your ready design, website improvements (new pages, blocks, features), support after launch and website audits. Tell us which service you are interested in, and we will give you a price estimate.
